approval_ref: The active goal requires a verifiable advanced-model reference implementation; the approved fixed gate cannot be proven from ordinary accepted/rejected result review alone.
notes: Add explicit human benchmark verdicts for terminal frozen-evaluation items without rewriting model results, citations, evidence or ordinary review.
Preserve expected-version concurrency and append-only before/after adjudication history.
Compute the existing fixed 15-question release threshold only from immutable contract outcomes and explicit engineer verdicts.
Exclude Mock profiles, incomplete work, model-disabled outcomes and unreviewed items from a passing gate.
Make no external model call and do not claim that the stronger-model benchmark has run.
Validated with 38 focused Python contract/UI tests, 24 localization tests, JavaScript syntax checks and the complete 1,521-test Python suite.
title: Human Reference benchmark adjudication and release scorecard
objective: Let an engineer independently adjudicate every terminal fixed-benchmark answer and have CIRP compute the approved release threshold without inferring correctness or calling a model.
